rows.label: No formal-tool execution result
rows.evaluation_implication: The run cannot support a CBMC verification conclusion.

rows.label: Tool, build, instrumentation, or timeout failure
rows.evaluation_implication: Resolve tool/model execution problems before semantic conclusions.

rows.label: One or more emitted properties failed
rows.evaluation_implication: Counterexample analysis and candidate repair may be relevant.

rows.label: One or more emitted properties were unknown
Failed and unknown properties coexist
rows.evaluation_implication: Keep failed and unknown claims separate in analysis.

rows.label: Bounded selected-property success
rows.evaluation_implication: Success is limited to the recorded harness, claims, assumptions and model.

rows.label: Selected-property traceability incomplete
rows.evaluation_implication: Successful emitted claims do not establish the selected property.

rows.label: CBMC output was not structured JSON
rows.evaluation_implication: No scientific property result is permitted.

rows.label: No emitted property evidence
rows.evaluation_implication: Repair instrumentation or evidence generation before interpretation.

rows.label: Tool execution and evidence are inconsistent
rows.evaluation_implication: Resolve the contradiction before reporting a result.

rows.label: Analysis-only run
rows.evaluation_implication: No CBMC proof claim is made.

rows.label: Unrecognized Agent 7 result label
rows.evaluation_implication: Repair the cross-agent result contract before continuing.

rows.label: Review gate prevented tool execution
rows.evidence_basis: review_gate={'final_gate': 'blocked_hard_tool_readiness_defect', 'tool_execution_allowed': False, 'reason': 'The reviewed artefact bundle failed route-specific frontend parse/build readiness.'}
rows.evaluation_implication: Human review or artefact revision is required before a real tool-execution attempt.

limitations: This taxonomy is derived from logged run evidence through the shared Agent 7 result contract.
It does not infer implementation bugs without supporting CBMC/tool evidence.
